response.original_title: Kenny: The True Story of Msgr. Ken Leone
response.overview: "Kenny" tells the inspiring true story of Monsignor Ken Leone, beloved Catholic priest of the Archdiocese of Denver whose fifty-year ministry transformed countless lives across the Front Range. Known for his zany personality and deep personal care for each individual, Msgr. Ken embodied what it means to be Jesus to every person you meet.  From his early calling to the priesthood through decades of dedicated service, leadership, and quiet acts of extraordinary grace, this 58-minute feature documentary offers an intimate look at a life completely poured out for others.
response.title: Kenny: The True Story of Msgr. Ken Leone
